summary: Vitalist Water — Order & Delivery Management System. Enterprise-grade web app managing the full order-to-delivery lifecycle for a water distribution business. Features role-based access control (Admin, Staff, Delivery, Distributor), GPS store mapping, automated invoice generation, encrypted QR code workflow, camera-based QR scanning, 4-stage controlled delivery workflow, date-based reporting, and a Distributor portal for tracking deliveries with truck/driver info, barcode scanning, and image uploads. No financial/profit module included.
architectural_notes: No financial/profit module — intentionally excluded from scope
Order IDs are auto-incremented in format VW-YYYY-XXXX and cannot be manually edited
QR codes are only generated after admin approval and cannot be regenerated without admin authority
All 4 delivery stages require camera-based QR scanning; no manual QR entry permitted
GPS location must be captured at Stage 3 (Delivery Start) and Stage 4 (Delivery Complete)
Orders are permanently locked after Stage 4 completion — no re-scan or modification allowed
All workflow stages log timestamps; duplicate scans are blocked at every stage
Distributor is a 4th role — Admin generates distributor credentials; distributors track their own deliveries via a dedicated portal
Admin can input distributor delivery data (truck no, driver contact) which surfaces in the Distributor panel
known_issues: Sidebar navigation options are not visible by default — they only appear on hover/focus; sidebar should show all options visibly at all times
Admin panel shows 'only admin can add/edit' error when attempting to add/edit stores or other records — role detection or permission check is incorrectly blocking admin actions
Add Store map is broken or non-functional — needs investigation and fix

existing_features.title: Implement a role-based authentication system with three roles: Admin, Staff, and Delivery. Store users in the backend with email, hashed password, and role. Pre-seed three demo accounts: admin@vitalist.com / India@123 (Admin), staff@vitalist.com / India@123 (Staff), delivery@vitalist.com / India@123 (Delivery). On login, return a session token and role. Enforce role-based route guards on the frontend so each role only accesses permitted pages. Admin can add, edit, and delete user accounts.

Implement a Store Management module. Each store record stores: Store Name, Owner Name, Mobile Number, Full Address, Landmark, Latitude, Longitude, and Creation Timestamp. The Add Store form includes a 'Use Current Location' button that auto-fills Latitude and Longitude using the browser Geolocation API, plus a live map preview (using an embedded map or coordinate display) with a manual pin/coordinate adjustment option. Admin can add, edit, and delete stores. Stores are listed in a searchable table.

Implement the Order Creation flow for Staff. The form includes: Select Store (dropdown from store list), Quantity, Rate, and Notes. On submission, the backend auto-generates a unique Order ID in the format VW-YYYY-XXXX (e.g., VW-2026-0001) using the current year and an auto-incrementing counter. The backend sets the order status to 'Pending Approval', stores the creation timestamp, and creates a draft invoice record. Order IDs must be unique with no duplicates and cannot be manually set.

Implement the Admin Order Approval flow. Admin views all orders with 'Pending Approval' status and can approve or cancel them. On approval, the status changes to 'Approved' and a QR code is generated containing the encrypted Order ID (base64 or simple encoding of the Order ID string). The QR code is stored linked to the order. One QR per order; QR cannot be regenerated once created without admin explicitly triggering regeneration (which requires cancelling the existing QR). Cancelled orders are marked as 'Cancelled' and locked.

Implement camera-based QR scanning using the device camera (via jsQR or a React QR scanner library). When a user taps/clicks 'Scan QR', the camera opens in a modal/overlay and scans in real-time without manual entry. On successful scan, the encoded Order ID is extracted, the order is fetched from the backend, the current stage transition is validated, and the status is updated. No manual QR code text entry is permitted in the scanning flow.

Implement the mobile-optimized Delivery Panel. Display a list of orders assigned to the logged-in delivery user (status: Dispatched or Out for Delivery). Each order card shows: Store Name, Owner Contact Number, estimated distance to store (calculated from stored GPS coordinates and current device location), an 'Open in Google Maps' button (deep link with store latitude/longitude), and a large 'Scan QR' button. When delivery is started (Stage 3 scan), initiate a delivery timer. The panel must be fully responsive and optimized for mobile screens.

Implement the Advanced Order Management Panel for Admin. Features: view all orders in a paginated/scrollable table; filter by date range (From/To in DD-MM-YYYY format), by store, and by status; search by Order ID; view full order details in a modal/drawer; download invoice PDF; monitor delivery progress per order. The backend must support query parameters for date-range filtering, store filtering, status filtering, and Order ID search.

Implement the professional SaaS UI shell. Include a fixed left sidebar with navigation items: Dashboard, Stores, Orders, Invoices, QR Management, Reports, Settings. The Dashboard shows summary cards for: Total Orders Today, Pending, Ready, Out for Delivery, and Delivered. The layout must be fully responsive with a collapsible/hamburger sidebar on mobile. Apply a water-blue corporate theme with soft shadows, smooth transitions, and clean typography throughout all pages.

Apply a cohesive visual theme across the entire application: water-blue primary palette (deep ocean blues and clear aqua accents), clean white backgrounds, subtle soft-shadow cards, bold sans-serif typography, smooth hover and transition animations, and a professional distribution SaaS aesthetic. The Vitalist Water brand name and logo/wordmark should appear in the sidebar header and on invoices.

Fix the sidebar navigation in AppSidebar.tsx and Layout.tsx so that all navigation items (Dashboard, Stores, Orders, Invoices, QR Management, Reports, Settings) are fully visible at all times by default — not hidden or invisible until hovered/focused. Remove any CSS or Tailwind classes that hide nav item labels, icons, or the sidebar itself in its default (non-collapsed) state. Ensure text labels, icons, and active/inactive states are always rendered with sufficient color contrast and opacity (no opacity-0, invisible, or transparent styling on nav items unless the sidebar is explicitly in a user-toggled collapsed state on mobile).

Fix the frontend AuthContext and any permission-guard logic in StoreManagementPage.tsx, UserManagementPage.tsx, OrderManagementPage.tsx, and any other admin pages so that the current user's role is correctly read and passed to backend calls. Ensure the session token and role stored in sessionStorage are correctly read back on page load/refresh and that all admin action buttons (Add, Edit, Delete, Approve, Cancel) are enabled and functional for the admin role without being gated by a faulty role check.

Add a 'Distributor Delivery Data' management section in the Admin panel. Admin can create, edit, and delete distributor delivery records. Each record stores: Order ID (linked to an existing order), Truck Number, Driver Name, Driver Contact Number, Distributor (linked user with 'distributor' role), Estimated Delivery Date/Time, and any additional Notes. The backend must persist these records and expose query functions to list all records (admin) and filter by distributor user (distributor role).

Create a Distributor portal/panel (accessible only to users with the 'distributor' role) that displays all distributor delivery records assigned to the logged-in distributor. Each card/row shows: Order ID, linked Store Name, Truck Number, Driver Name, Driver Contact Number, Estimated Delivery Date/Time, and current Order Status. The distributor can mark an order as 'Truck Arrived' once they have received the delivery at their location. The panel must be mobile-responsive.

Fix the 'Add Store' and 'Edit Store' map functionality in StoreManagementPage.tsx. The map preview and coordinate display must correctly render using the browser Geolocation API for 'Use Current Location', and the manual coordinate input fields (Latitude, Longitude) must be editable and kept in sync with the map display. Remove any dependency on external map tile providers that may be blocked or broken; use an OpenStreetMap iframe embed or a plain coordinate display with a Leaflet/static map fallback so the map always renders without errors.

new_feature_requests.summary: Role-based access control: Admin, Staff, Delivery roles with distinct permissions
Demo login credentials for Admin, Staff, and Delivery roles
Store management with GPS smart mapping, live map preview, manual pin adjustment
Order creation by Staff with auto-incremented Order ID (VW-YYYY-XXXX), draft invoice, pending approval status
Automated invoice generation with logo, order details, QR code (post-approval), PDF download/print/share
Secure QR code system: generated only after admin approval, encrypted order ID, one QR per order, no regeneration without admin
Camera-based QR scanning (no manual entry): auto-opens camera, real-time scan, order fetch and status update

4-stage controlled workflow: Admin Scan (Approved→Ready), Staff Scan (Ready→Dispatched), Delivery Start (Dispatched→Out for Delivery), Delivery Complete (Out for Delivery→Delivered) with GPS, timestamps, duplicate scan blocking
Mobile-optimized delivery panel: assigned orders, store contact, distance, Google Maps button, Scan QR button, real-time dashboard updates
Advanced order management panel: filter by date range/store/status, search by Order ID, view details, download invoice
Professional SaaS UI: sidebar navigation, dashboard overview (Today/Pending/Ready/Out for Delivery/Delivered), water-blue theme, responsive layout

Implement the 4-stage controlled order workflow with QR scanning at each stage. Stage 1 (Admin Scan): Admin scans QR; status changes from 'Approved' to 'Ready'; packing confirmed; timestamp saved; duplicate scan blocked. Stage 2 (Staff Scan): Staff scans QR; status changes from 'Ready' to 'Dispatched'; handover confirmed; timestamp logged. Stage 3 (Delivery Scan – Start): Delivery user scans QR; status changes from 'Dispatched' to 'Out for Delivery'; GPS coordinates captured; delivery timer started; timestamp logged. Stage 4 (Delivery Scan – Complete): Delivery user scans QR again; status changes from 'Out for Delivery' to 'Delivered'; GPS coordinates captured; order permanently locked; no re-scan permitted. Each stage transition is validated server-side to enforce ordering; scanning an already-processed QR at the wrong stage is rejected.

Implement the Automated Invoice System. An invoice is created as a draft when an order is placed. The invoice includes: Vitalist Water branding, Order ID, Invoice Number, Store details and address, Quantity, Rate, Total Amount (Quantity × Rate), Date & Time, and the QR code image (only after admin approval). Admin can view the invoice and trigger a print-friendly PDF download using browser print or a library like jsPDF/html2canvas. The invoice updates automatically when the order reaches 'Delivered' status.

Enforce all system validation rules in the backend: orders cannot be approved without being in 'Pending Approval' status; QR codes are never generated before approval; Order IDs are unique and auto-incremented; duplicate QR scans at any stage are rejected; all stage transitions are enforced in sequence; orders are permanently locked after 'Delivered'; all stage timestamps are recorded; GPS coordinates are required for Stage 3 and Stage 4 scans.

Fix the backend role-based access control in backend/main.mo so that when an authenticated admin user calls addStore, updateStore, deleteStore, addUser, updateUser, deleteUser, approveOrder, cancelOrder, or any other admin-restricted function, the caller's role is correctly resolved to 'admin' and the operation is permitted without returning an 'only admin can add/edit' error. Investigate whether the caller principal is being matched correctly to the stored user record and whether the MixinAuthorization check is comparing the right identity.

Add Distributor role: Admin can generate distributor login credentials. Distributor portal shows delivery tracking (order location, truck number, driver contact). Distributor scans barcode and uploads images of truck loaded/unloaded, then marks 'truck arrived' after delivery at their location.
Admin panel: Add 'Add Distributor Delivery Data' option. Data entered by admin (truck no, driver contact, order info) is reflected in the Distributor panel in real time.
Fix 'Add Store' map issue — map is broken or not functioning correctly when adding a store.

Professional corporate login page redesign: remove demo credentials display, add Distributor login option alongside existing roles. Login credentials: shajan@vitalist.com / India@123. Admin generates IDs for distributor/staff/delivery users.
